sources.entry: Feather Wiki - A lightning fast and infinitely extensible tool for creating personal non-linear notebooks, databases, and wikis that is entirely self-contained, runs in your browser, and is only 58 kilobytes in size. (Demo, Source Code, Clients) AGPL-3.0 Javascript

summary.name: Feather Wiki
summary.one_liner: A tiny, self-contained wiki and personal notebook tool that runs in the browser as a single file of about 58 KB.
use_cases: Keeping a personal wiki or notebook
Building a small database-style notes collection
Creating a wiki that runs without a server
Organizing linked notes in one portable file
summary.what_it_does: Feather Wiki is described as a tool for creating personal non-linear notebooks, databases, and wikis. According to the listing, it is entirely self-contained, runs in the browser, and is about 58 kilobytes in size. The page navigation shows sections for creating and editing pages, Markdown support, search, auto-save, data import/export, and a Publishing section. It also lists an extension system with features such as full search, transclusion, auto table of contents, and word count. The page text itself contains mostly menu structure and few concrete details beyond these.
notable: Entire wiki is self-contained at about 58 KB and runs in the browser
Extensible through an extension system with documented helper functions and global objects
Supports Markdown, auto-save, full search, and data import/export
Licensed under AGPL-3.0 and built with JavaScript
caveats: Known limitations are listed on the site but their details are not in the page text
Platform support beyond the browser is not stated on this page
